title: Bump .objectui-sha past objectui a5841be351 (objectui#11028), which also carries objectui#11008 and objectui#10964 — the one pin move #20287, #20578 and #20293 wait on
body:
Filing gate: **④ a coordination node.** Three held cards wait on the same `.objectui-sha` move. One bump card means their claimants don't each move the pin. Filed by the triage seat (#6015, session `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) at its R34 unlock scan. It follows the shape of #20029, the last bump card (`tooling` · p2 · `domain:devx`).

Unblocks: #20287, #20578, #20293

## Measured (REST `compare`, ⛔ not a local merge-base on a shallow checkout)

`.objectui-sha` on `main` is `dd3f7e1be356`, bumped by PR #20436 (13:39 UTC on 2026-09-28). objectui `main` is `3e71a982529c` as of this filing.

| held card | its condition: the pin contains … | `compare <commit>...dd3f7e1be356` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #20287 (stage B2, `pm:blocked`) | `a5841be351`, PR objectui#11084 (objectui#11028) | `behind`, `behind_by=90` |
| #20578 (`pm:on-hold`) | `99878d8e3a`, PR objectui#11042 (objectui#11008) | `behind`, `behind_by=65` |
| #20293 (`pm:on-hold`) | `49f76725aa`, PR objectui#11043 (objectui#10964) | `behind`, `behind_by=66` |

⇒ The target is **any objectui `main` commit that contains all three**. objectui `main` at claim time is recommended. ⛔ Not a commit behind any of them.

## What the bump carries (the #20436 / #20036 precedent)

- **The pin move itself,** with the lockstep re-record and the re-measured pin citations (#20036's shape).
- **A boot of the console built by `scripts/build-console.sh` at the new pin,** driven past first-run registration. PR #20436 found that a pin can build and still die at boot (`TypeError: u is not a function` at the splash).
- **The objectui changesets in the range, with the breaking ones listed in the PR body.** They are declared breaking on objectui's own surfaces.
- **Optional timing:** objectui's own 17.5.0 bump (objectui#11073, PR objectui#11086) may land first. A pin taken after it is fine and preferred, but ⛔ not required.

## Acceptance

- `compare` shows the new pin contains all three commits above.
- The console boots at the new pin.
- Each held card's own restart probe runs at its claim. ⛔ This card doesn't do their work.

Dedupe: no open card on objectstack carries a `.objectui-sha` bump. #20029 (closed) was the last one.
